6442.title: Plugin-scoped base utilities defeat touch preview sizing
6442.rootCauseOneLine: Later plugin-scoped base utilities tie core responsive utilities in specificity and override the core header inside a plugin root.

prReviews.topFinding: Minimum-height classes mitigate this header collision but do not repair the general core/plugin cascade contract.

6442.proposedFix: Consider a header-local minimum-height mitigation; separately decide how core islands retain responsive/state utility precedence under plugin scopes.
6442.caveats: Isolated real-component/CSS browser reproduction, repeated by the same agent from a second clean checkout. No full third-party plugin workflow, physical iOS Safari, or PR branch execution.
